claim_boundary: This is an agent-produced proposal overlay. It is not a Phase-B submission, expert review, independent review, registry admission, tier lift, or freeze decision.
All 57 Phase-B packets remain unreviewed. No frozen Phase-A or Phase-B artifact is changed.
Official M-CSA checks establish entry identity, reaction, and available mechanism detail only; they do not establish fingerprint-wide equivalence or applicability.
Historical curated_mechanism_labels rows are prior automation outputs used only as discovery locators, never as gold or verified corrections.

method.authoritative_external_inspection: Current official M-CSA API records were checked for every Phase-A M-CSA handle. Selected high-impact omissions and contradictions were checked on official M-CSA entry pages.
not_run: Rhea row retrieval beyond inherited handles

source_coverage_findings.root_cause: The Phase-A selection source index is built from the 40 candidate rows plus Atlas-3/Atlas-10 selections, not from the broader incumbent source stack.
source_coverage_findings.interpretation: An empty Phase-A row means not found in the bounded selection index; it is not evidence that the source universe has no relevant object.
